The Special Land Acquisition Officer, shortly, LAO, awarded an amount of Rs.2769/- towards compensation for the acquired land, which the private Respondent (Petitioner before the Court below)

Hence, this Appeal.

the impugned judgment, being passed relying on Ext.1, is perverse and deserves to be set aside.

5. In response to such submission made by the learned CGC, Mr. Mohanty, learned Counsel for the private Respondent,
drawing attention of this Court to the observations made by the Court below in paragraph 10 of the impugned judgment,
submitted that the Court below consciously took note of the said fact that Ext.1 does not disclose the kisam of land, for which the compensation was awarded.

It also observed that kisam of land of the Private Respondent (Petitioner before the L.A.A. No. 57 of 2011 Page 3 of 7  Court below) are "Khet Adi & Bahal" and though the Bahal kisam of land is the best kisam of land and the compensation should have been more, applying the Principle of guess estimate, the Court below has rightly enhanced the compensation to Rs.35,000/- per acre.
There being no infirmity or illegality in the impugned judgment, the Appeal deserves to be dismissed and direction be given to the Appellant to comply the said judgment within a stipulated period.

6. Learned Counsel for the Respondents further submitted that though the Court below was of the view that the Private Respondent should be paid at par with the Petitioner of Ext.1, still it reduced the compensation to Rs.35,000/- per Union Of India vs Somnath Sahu & on 6 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/188358694/
3 acre, instead of Rs.54,000/- per acre.

Learned Counsel for the private Respondent, drawing attention of this Court to paragraph Nos. 6 & 7 of the examination-in-chief of P.W. No.1,
further submitted that lands of one Paramananda Sahu of kisam Berna, Mala & Atta were acquired, which was the subject matter in MJC No.186 of 1997 and the Court below awarded a sum of Rs.60,000/- as market value of the land for acquiring Acre 1.11 decimal of land of Paramananda Sahu.

It was specifically stated by P.W.1 that valuation of land per acre as per Ext.1 comes to Rs.54,054/- and the said evidence of P.W.1 L.A.A. No. 57 of 2011 Page 4 of 7  remained un-touched during his cross-examination.
Despite such evidence on record, the Court below enhanced the compensation to Rs.35,000/- per acre only, though it should have been more.

It is found from the judgment  passed by this court in M.J.C. No. 186 of  1997 (Ext.1) that Act, 1.11 decs of land was  acquired by the O.P. Considering the facts and  circumstances of this case and evidence  adduced by both the parties it is felt by the  court that the petitioners are entitled to get  the compensation for their acquired land  more than the amount given by O.P. No.1  and at par with the petitioner of Ext.1  xxxxxxxx".
